physical_role_binding.DMA_A: one actual existing iDMA requester behind shared RISC-V IOMMU; root to bind verified DID
physical_role_binding.DMA_B: a second actual existing iDMA requester behind the same IOMMU; root to bind verified DID
physical_role_binding.CUDA_stream_to_DID_mapping: prohibited: source CUDA streams are not separate physical device identities
physical_role_binding.storage_role: DRAM file-image proxy only; no NVMe protocol emulation
physical_role_binding.GPU_role: DRAM target proxy only; no GPU endpoint/compute emulation

fpga_transfer_DAG.barrier_policy: all A/B transfers drain at package_ready; no next packet begins automatically

source_runtime.source_queue_capacity: queue.Queue without explicit bound; actual loop joins each batch
source_runtime.source_home_lifetime: init_all_weights through delete_all_weights; copied homes remain immutable
source_runtime.source_destination_lifetime: weight_read_buf kept for reuse until last microbatch donation
source_runtime.source_relay_reuse: same worker executes relay-fill then destination-copy in its CUDA copy_stream; projected reuse must wait actual B completion

projection_common_budget.extra_not_included: IOMMU/page tables/CPU and DMA caches, guards, DMA descriptors, completion metadata, Linux/application memory and any real source storage cache
projection_common_budget.relay_reason: complete finite six-tensor packet can fit in one full-packet relay; no artificial tiny capacity or long stream needed
projection_common_budget.same_budget_rule: all compared schedules get this same relay budget and may partition/recycle it legally

ownership_rules: home initialized and visible before DMA_A authorization; remains immutable until release
A_i exclusively writes its relay range; B_i cannot read until A_i actual complete plus required visibility ordering
relay range stays live through B_i actual complete; no overwrite on B submission alone
B_i exclusively writes destination range; CPU verifier waits all six B complete plus required visibility ordering
all comparisons include the same role permissions/mapping lifetime; persistent mappings and legal prewarming are allowed
each real DMA completion, error, bytes, transfer id and outstanding count must be retained; terminal outstanding must be zero

ordinary_executable_baselines.schedule: For i=0..5: issue A_i, wait A_i done/visibility; issue B_i, wait B_i done/visibility; reuse relay. Join, verify, release.
ordinary_executable_baselines.remaining_common_budget: unused capacity still available; no competitor penalized for unused bytes
ordinary_executable_baselines.source_relation: conservative per-worker two-copy serialization with hardware completion gates; not original GPU latency

ordinary_executable_baselines.schedule: Allocate disjoint full-packet relay offsets. Run all six A transfers, wait all A complete/visibility. Run all six B transfers. Join, verify, release.
ordinary_executable_baselines.why_strong: completely pre-prepares the finite packet; no claimed inability to prepare large chunks or arbitrary deadline

ordinary_executable_baselines.schedule: Use same full-packet relay allocator and ordinary dependency queue. Issue A/B as dependencies and actual DMA front-end capacity allow; permit A for another tensor while B consumes a completed disjoint region. No fixed two-slot restriction. Join, verify, release.
allowed_optimizations: full-packet preparation before transfer interval, charged separately in end-to-end cost
direct home->destination one-hop DMA as a separate semantic-equivalent memory-proxy control with explicit different traffic

ordinary_executable_baselines.schedule: If proxy target can legally read home directly, issue ordinary one-hop home->destination transfers for all six tensors; wait done, verify and release.
ordinary_executable_baselines.reason: On board DRAM endpoint placement a relay is not physically mandatory. Any two-hop benefit must survive this simpler legal control or be explicitly restricted to the two-hop contract; cannot claim real offload advantage from forcing an unnecessary hop.

legal_scaling.preferred: Use full six-tensor h=768 supported configuration package above; smaller than default 6.7B without changing tensor formula/dtype. This is a different model-family instance and a phase fragment, not the paper benchmark.
legal_scaling.relay_tightening: source accesses cpu_buf[:size] only; for a finite known tensor set its per-worker allocation can be reduced to the largest assigned tensor if worker count/queue semantics and overlap are counted. This is an explicit source adaptation, not unmodified execution.
legal_scaling.chunking: If DMA descriptor limits require chunking, split a tensor into contiguous byte ranges whose sizes are even and whose union exactly covers [0,tensor_bytes). Maintain per-chunk A->B completion and relay lifetime; tensor_ready requires all chunks; package_ready requires all six tensors. Source MLP loader copies whole tensors, so chunking is an explicit adaptation with extra descriptors/fences counted.
legal_scaling.selected_slice: A partial tensor slice can be a size projection only if explicitly called a selected slice; must not be called complete layer/package. Not used here.
legal_scaling.custom_config: get_opt_config kwargs permit dataclasses.replace but pretrained weights are not resized/obtained; arbitrary hidden-size shrink does not preserve OPT-125m model behavior. Not used here.
